claim: Paper protocol has unresolved 60/20/20 versus first-20% ambiguity
allowed_paper_claim: The local work uses an explicitly declared target-prefix protocol.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim a fully unique reconstruction of the paper protocol.

claim: Paper-style fusion has a catastrophic output mode
metric/evidence: 25 catastrophic validation predictions across 10 paper-fusion runs.
allowed_paper_claim: Unconstrained paper-style fusion was unstable under the audited small-prefix protocol.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call this a proof of failure on every dataset or protocol.

claim: Bounded residual fusion removes the observed catastrophic mode
metric/evidence: catastrophic count 25 -> 0; residual configurations still fail accuracy gate.
allowed_paper_claim: Bounding corrections is a robustness-engineering safeguard in this setting.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim it solves SOH generalization or is the paper's original formula.

claim: Shorter fusion sequence is the main cure
metric/evidence: seq=4 increases usable samples but no configuration qualifies.
allowed_paper_claim: Sequence shortening is not a primary remedy here.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present a best sequence length as a general solution.

claim: Fusion capacity is the main cause
metric/evidence: parameter/sample ratio drops from 1793 to 3.8 without qualification.
allowed_paper_claim: Capacity alone does not explain the failure.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not reopen capacity grids as a thesis innovation.

metric/evidence: Oracle STL reconstruction R2=1; predicted-component reconstruction R2=-13.019/-13.642.
allowed_paper_claim: Upstream component forecasting is a necessary failure layer before learned fusion.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim fusion weights are the sole root cause.

claim: Trend is the only component bottleneck
metric/evidence: Trend has largest single substitution degradation, but residual/seasonal errors are material.
allowed_paper_claim: Trend is important but not sufficient as a standalone target.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not frame a trend-only replacement as validated.

claim: GAN is a uniform cause or remedy
metric/evidence: REAL_ONLY reconstruction RMSE=5.832; REAL+GAN=6.695; mixed component effects.
allowed_paper_claim: GAN effects are battery-specific in the diagnostic.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not say removing or adding GAN consistently improves transfer.

claim: Complex/lightweight component replacements solve the issue
metric/evidence: TimesNet/iTransformer, Ridge, tiny MLP and tiny GRU do not establish a robust component replacement.
allowed_paper_claim: More or less component capacity is not a validated thesis method.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim a lightweight replacement wins cross-battery.

metric/evidence: Mean KS .562/.573; B0007 relationship-shift evidence is stronger.
allowed_paper_claim: Covariate/relationship shift is a plausible upstream generalization stressor.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not identify a physical mechanism or claim causation from association.

claim: STL prefix instability is the primary causal explanation
metric/evidence: Causal EMA/median are prefix stable but have no >=1% Ridge RMSE improvement.
allowed_paper_claim: Prefix instability alone is insufficient in the fixed diagnostic.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not generalize this null to every possible decomposition/model.

metric/evidence: S2 zero-shot R2=.658 for B0007 vs .149 for B0018; calibrated B0007 R2=.916 but B0018 no material gain.
allowed_paper_claim: Transfer benefit depends on target/source combination.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call calibrated results zero-shot or universal.

claim: B0006 creates source-specific negative transfer risk
allowed_paper_claim: Indiscriminate source pooling can carry negative-transfer risk.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer the physical reason for B0006 incompatibility.

claim: B0005 is uniformly a good source
metric/evidence: B0005-only zero-shot R2=.886/.428; effects are only two targets and protocol-specific.
allowed_paper_claim: B0005 is useful development evidence in this source bank.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not hard-code B0005 or claim universal source superiority.

claim: Unsupervised HF-distance selection predicts transfer utility
metric/evidence: It selects B0006 for both targets; selected-source loses to all-source in all four contrasts.
allowed_paper_claim: Simple covariate nearest-neighbor distance is not a valid utility score here.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not redesign/tune another HF-distance score or read test to rescue it.

metric/evidence: B0018 selects B0005 and improves C1 (1.377 vs 1.565); B0007 selects B0006 and loses to C1 (2.654 vs .589).
allowed_paper_claim: Prefix supervision can have battery-specific utility under calibrated/few-shot transfer.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim a general effective source-selection algorithm or proceed to test.

claim: Source compatibility is a physical causal mechanism
metric/evidence: Support mismatch and conditional residual diagnostics are associative; two selection rules are not stable.
allowed_paper_claim: Source compatibility is an audit construct associated with transfer risk.

metric/evidence: No CALCE/independent confirmation; both candidate screening methods fail/partial.
allowed_paper_claim: The thesis scope is NASA reproduction and negative-transfer audit.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim CALCE or cross-dataset generality.
